suggestion: Schedule the existing official fetch workflow weekly (and before each week's first reporting day) so schedule changes like the Nov 9 Week 11 move are caught within days, not discovered later.
decision_needed: Enable scheduled runs against main; add a diff report of changed official rows.
benefit: Prevents stale rows (IR-022 class) from reaching the leaderboard's grading substrate.
source_label: NFL.com Week 11 schedule change (the missed-change example)

suggestion: Show a per-row last-verified age and a visible STALE badge when an official announcement post-dates a row's capture; link the correcting announcement on the row.
decision_needed: Approve the badge design; decide whether stale rows stay visible with the badge or move to a quarantine table.
benefit: Line-origination decisions stop relying on silently outdated rows.

suggestion: Capture the official injury report every reporting day and render per-team availability deltas (DNP/Limited/Out counts + key absences) next to each game row on the daily scoreboard.
decision_needed: Approve weekly-capture storage layout and the delta display.
benefit: Makes the availability signal (G-01) usable for line origination without manual reading of 32 team tables.

suggestion: Build a per-club depth-order collection from official club announcements/sites since NFL.com does not publish depth order (IR-023); start with FOCUS clubs, expand gradually.
decision_needed: Confirm the depth-order authority per club and storage schema.
benefit: Unlocks the starter-to-backup downgrade signal (G-02) and the deficiency metrics (D-01–D-03).
source_label: NFL.com team depth-chart URL (404 evidence, IR-023)

suggestion: Select a licensed, legally accessible market-data source for opening/closing lines; store odds with provenance like every other source. Nothing in this module can grade CLV (V-03) or measure correlation (C-01–C-05) until this is decided.
decision_needed: OWNER DECISION (Q2): provider, jurisdiction/legal review, budget.
benefit: Unblocks the primary skill-vs-luck mechanism of the whole leaderboard.
source_label: NFL integrity & betting policy (no official odds source exists)

suggestion: Add a live leaderboard page rendering per-division standings from a graded-selections JSON once the grading pipeline exists; every row links to the official result sources used.
decision_needed: Approve scoring formula weights (B-03/B-04) before implementation.
benefit: Makes the competition auditable and reward-eligible statuses visible.

suggestion: Publish an explicit risk policy for any real-world use: bankroll unit definition, max exposure per game/day, parlay-leg cap, and a hard rule that no strategy is 'live' until gates V1–V8 pass.
decision_needed: OWNER DECISION (Q1/Q6): values and enforcement point.
benefit: Removes the largest decision-risk: acting on unvalidated strategies.

suggestion: Add CSV/JSON export buttons to every table (data rows already carry structured source URLs).
decision_needed: Low-risk; approve and implement in a build pass.
benefit: Lets reviewers analyze rows offline and keeps sessions from re-scraping.
source_label: Repo official event JSON (existing structured data)

suggestion: Per-club pages: next game, availability snapshot, recent transactions, roster ACT changes, and our model's own number when one exists.
decision_needed: Approve page template; data feeds exist or are proposed above.
benefit: Turns the module from league-wide tables into decision-ready team views.

suggestion: Give the Suggestions page an explicit owner-review loop: each suggestion gets a decision record (decided/approved/rejected + date) appended to COORDINATION.md before any implementation begins.
decision_needed: OWNER DECISION (Q10): who reviews and approves.
benefit: Satisfies the requirement that suggestions are reviewed before changes, and keeps parallel sessions coordinated.
